items.description: A major oil export terminal located in Akwa Ibom State. It serves as a critical node for Nigeria's offshore oil production.
An industrial cement manufacturing complex situated in Edo State. It plays a significant role in local infrastructure development.
The first multi-story building in Nigeria, built in Badagry in 1845 by Christian missionaries. It stands as a significant architectural landmark.
A historic residential building in Calabar that reflects colonial architecture. It represents the early administrative history of the region.
The primary national mosque of Nigeria located in the capital city, Abuja. It is a prominent cultural and religious monument.
A cable-stayed bridge in Lagos connecting the Lekki and Ikoyi districts. It is a modern engineering feat improving urban mobility.
A iconic skyscraper in Lagos serving as a major office complex. It remains one of the tallest buildings in Nigeria.
A large, multi-purpose sports stadium located in the national capital, Abuja. It is a central venue for major athletic events.
The first skyscraper in West Africa, located in Ibadan. It was built using proceeds from the regional cocoa industry.
A large business and leisure resort located in Calabar, Cross River State. It features international trade facilities and entertainment venues.
